guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research
guides.concept: 以公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環解析Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research through public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EGS熱與連通。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識研究井完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識假想發電循環選擇。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識換熱與礦物證據。結垢降低熱傳且影響流阻；化學腐蝕與機械磨耗不是同一機制。 建立換熱結垢與腐蝕的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識示蹤與thermal return。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開microseismic目錄。地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。 建立微震監測與生態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify egs heat/connectivity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify research-well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify assumed-cycle choice in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify transfer/mineral evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tracer/thermal return in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify public microseismic catalogs in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Subsurface changes need site rules/monitoring; seismic, fluid and ecological data have distinct metrics. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microseismic monitoring and environment, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交示蹤與thermal return的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交公開microseismic目錄的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for tracer/thermal return.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public microseismic catalogs.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：單一發電指標可替代地震及環境監測。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: One generation metric replaces seismic/environmental monitoring.

related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。

related.difference: 本課針對公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環；Krafla 地熱與回注系統改以火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
